title: A fictional online marketplace · Operation and the regulators' action

sources.name: First-instance judgment in this case (fictional)

loc.court: Example District People's Court, Example City, Example Province

sources.quote: As the builder, manager and operator of the mall system, Yunji Mall Co. must bear by law the duty to review and manage product information.

sources.name: Administrative warning by the market regulator (fictional)

loc.file: Administrative penalty record cited in the judgment

sources.quote: In March 2030 the Example City Market Supervision Bureau inspected Yunji Mall Co. and, because it had set up no system for reviewing product information and put no complaint-handling measures in place, gave it an administrative warning and ordered it to put this right.

sources.name: Penalty decision of the district market regulator (fictional)

loc.file: Administrative penalty record cited in the judgment

sources.quote: On 11 January 2031 the district market regulator found that Yunji Mall Co. had without permission sold food online where a permit is required, with goods carrying false labels, and penalised the company.

sources.name: Cooperation agreement between Yunji Mall Co. and Canglian Co. (fictional)
sources.quote: Canglian Co. supplies the hardware, four servers; Yunji Mall Co. supplies the product data source and a data transmission solution that lowers outgoing bandwidth and improves the user experience, and maintains the software and its content remotely.

sources.name: Expert opinion on the four servers (fictional)
sources.quote: The enforcement authority took 3,000 product pages from the servers for examination and found 2,100 of them to carry false labels.

events.label: Yunji Mall Co. is founded
events.detail: A limited liability company running the Yunji Mall website and app; it held a value-added telecom licence but, up to the day of the case, no permit for selling food online.

events.label: Regulator inspects and gives an administrative warning
events.detail: After its inspection the Example City Market Supervision Bureau gave an administrative warning and ordered correction, then sent Yunji Mall Co. the keywords and page links of falsely labelled goods and told it to take them down.

events.label: The mall launches a "patrol" information platform
events.detail: Yunji Mall Co. set up a compliance team for a rush of work and on 8 March put the "patrol" information management platform into use.

events.label: The mall reports 1,583 problem pages
events.summary: After sign-off the platform is left idle
events.detail: By 26 April 1,583 problem pages in the "false label" category had been reported; after the regulator signed it off, the four members of the compliance team left or moved to other departments and work on the "patrol" platform was largely put aside.

events.label: District regulator's on-site check finds falsely labelled goods
events.detail: Officers of the district market regulator logged in to the Yunji Mall app, opened the "recommended" section and soon found falsely labelled goods; the mall's manager Liu signed to confirm on the spot; Yunji Mall Co. then handed in only a rectification report.

events.label: The mall and Canglian Co. put four servers into service
events.detail: Canglian Co. supplied the four servers; Yunji Mall Co. installed the cache system software, logged in remotely with an account and password to maintain it, and was responsible for the data source and the system's content.

events.label: District regulator penalises the mall
events.detail: The district market regulator found that Yunji Mall Co. had without permission sold food online where a permit is required, and that the goods carried false labels, and imposed a penalty.

events.label: The four servers are seized
events.detail: During an enforcement inspection the district authority seized four servers from Canglian Co.; the enforcement authority took 3,000 product pages for examination and found 2,100 of them falsely labelled, over seventy percent.

events.label: The mall changes its cache to fragmented storage
events.summary: Storage changed at the manager's word
events.detail: To avoid regulatory checks and compliance risk, and at the word of the manager Chen, the technical department changed whole-page storage into fragments spread over several servers, each keeping only 32 MB pieces.
